quandoUsar: A centered theme button or one in a symmetric bar, when the new theme should open from a vertical slit in the middle of the screen.
When you want a short, symmetric swap (520 ms in the demo) that does not depend on where the button is.
quandoEvitar: Use `theme-switch` (`reveal` variant) when the transition should start from the button itself.
Use `theme-switch-rise` when the button is near the bottom of the screen and a rise fits better.

teclado.acao: Trigger the button, which calls `onThemeChange` with the next theme and `"split"`.

acessibilidade: It is the library's `button`, with `aria-pressed` true in the dark theme and `aria-hidden` icons; the demo shows the version with text and the icon-only one, both with the fixed `label` “Change appearance”.

In the version with text, the visible label is the fixed “Switch theme”, in English, and is not the button's name when there is a `label`; in a Portuguese interface, use `iconOnly` or replace that text in the installed file.
movimento: With `variant="split"`, the icon shifts 1 px to the right in the dark theme, on a spring curve, and returns when going back to light, while the sun and moon swap by rotating.

The page opening does not come with the component: in the demo, the new theme appears from a slit in the center that opens to the sides, clipping `::view-transition-new(root)` from `inset(0 50% 0 50%)` to `inset(0 0 0 0)`.
With “reduce motion”, the icon only fades and the shift happens without transition; the demo's utility also swaps the theme without animating the page.
notasIA: It is the same `ThemeSwitch` with `variant="split"`: import from `@/components/ryan-ui/theme-switch/theme-switch`; `onThemeChange` receives `"split"` as the second argument.
Implement the opening in the app: inside `document.startViewTransition`, apply the theme and animate the `clip-path` of `::view-transition-new(root)`; `trigger` is not needed for this variant.
`theme` is controlled and only accepts `light` or `dark`; skip the animation when `prefers-reduced-motion` is on, as the demo does.
